_comment: Evaluation topics. split=dev topics were used while developing rules and prompts; split=test topics are held out and must never be used for tuning. Each corpus = seed arXiv papers known to take different positions on the question + automatically discovered papers up to n_papers. Discovered papers must reach min_relevance (ranking score) to be added. split=fresh topics were added on 2026-10-07 for the one-off validation of the frozen E1 opposition detectors (eval/annotation/f1/PREREGISTRATION.md); they were never used for development.
